messages:
anya: Heads up — ran a long-chat workload on staging and hit a workspace OOM cascade. Looks like autosizer underprovisioned when KV cache churns. Full trace: https://staging.telemetry/redwood/trace/abc123 :eyeglasses:

mike: Can you paste the peak mem numbers / pprof snapshot?

anya: quick snapshot from profiler:
```
peak_gpu_mem: 36.2GB
slab_reserved: 28.7GB
ephemeral_allocs: 7.5GB
kv_cache_live: 2.4GB
headroom_reported: 600MB
OOM_event: at 36.7GB during attn fwd (flashattn -> triton fallback)
stack: runtime/allocator::alloc -> kernel-chooser -> flashattention
```

devon: Logs show kernel chooser flipped: preferred=flashattention_v2, chosen=triton_fwd at tail because workspace_required>available. Also saw repeated small KV writes causing reallocation churn.

mike: Noted. FlashAttention needs contiguous workspaces — when slab packing fails we fall back to Triton which increases workspace again. Two bad options stack.

anya: I tried a quick repro with margin_pct=15 -> fewer OOMs but still tails. margin_pct=20 eliminated repro locally but increased p95 by ~12ms on that trace.

sarah: Options: bump autosize margin for now, or implement a fast safety-net: on allocator failure trigger kvcache-evict(oldest 25%) and retry allocation. Cheaper than global OOM.

devon: We also have prototype branch kv-spill-host that async-copies cold KV entries to host pinned memory + background eviction. Adds network latency but stops OOMs.

mike: Short-term plan I'd push: 1) margin_pct=20 for the autosizer config (staging only), 2) kvevict-on-alloc-failure safety-net, 3) instrument telemetry to tag autosize.reason=kvcache_churn. Medium: canary kv-spill-host. Long: kernel chooser tweak to prefer cublaslt for FFN when seq_len<512 & batch>4.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout kv-spill-host to staging/cluster-2 started at 1732501400 — monitor: /deploys/kv-spill-host/1732501400

anya: I added trace tag autosize.reason=kv_churn to the traces and a small p99/p95 dashboard.

julian: For kernel chooser heuristics: also check for packed_slab_fragmentation metric before preferring flashattn. If fragmentation > 0.25 prefer cublaslt (FFN) or smaller FA kernel. That avoids repeated fallback thrash.

sarah: I'll file a perf regression ticket and attach current baseline numbers. Also adding eval harness with noisy KV churn to CI.

mike: Agree. Immediate merge targets: PR to bump margin_pct in staging config, PR for kvevict-on-failure, telemetry PR. Post-canary: evaluate latency delta and cost impact.

anya: PRs: https://git.redwood/pr/4567 (autosize bump), https://git.redwood/pr/4568 (kvevict-on-failure). Added notes in the PRs about p95 tradeoff.

devon: Quick note: when implementing kvevict-on-failure, make it bounded (max 50% of KV live) and async-safe (don't block tokens for >10ms).

mike: +1. Also add a fast path in kernel chooser: if allocator reports small spare slabs but not full, prefer kernels with smaller peak workspace (microprofile suggested cublaslt for our FFN shape).

anya: Thanks all — will watch staging telemetry and report back. :thumbsup:
